item.title: Lee, Lima, and Aquilani score Ignatz noms!
item.description: The Small Press Expo (SPX) just announced this year's slate of Ignatz Award nominations — and Top Shelf has three stellar nominees for two great books! The OUTSTANDING ARTIST category includes Kazimir Lee for Low Orbit, an atmospheric and profound coming-of-age graphic novel about a Malaysian-American teen carving out her own identity in the uneasy space between friends and family. item.title: SPX 2025 will be one for the record books!
item.description: Come discover a staggeringly stacked roster of Top Shelf talents this weekend at the Small Press Expo (SPX) in Bethesda/Rockville, Maryland! Get ready to meet EIGHT incredible authors, and lay your hands on FOUR books premiering at SPX before their street dates.

item.title: Learn from Top Shelf artists at NY Public Library!
item.description: Make the most of all the Top Shelf authors coming into town for New York Comic Con... by meeting them Wednesday, October 8 at New York Public Library's Midtown flagship branch! NYPL is holding "IDW Art Day" at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library (SNFL) all afternoon, with live art demos from a stellar lineup including Top Shelf authors Nick Bertozzi (Karmopolis), Dani Diaz (Dreamover), Kazimir Lee (Low Orbit), and Ben Wickey (More Weight). For details and free registration, click here!

item.title: BRIDGE PLANET NINE in stores now!
item.description: A heist gone wrong. In this gritty, intimate sci-fi graphic novel, four down-and-out thieves touch down on an abandoned colony planet for an easy heist… until the masks come off. "Expertly paced, Bridge Planet Nine is equal parts thrilling and original." — Chris Gooch, author of In Utero Bridge Planet Nine by Jared Throne $19.99 (US) | ISBN 978-1-60309-563-1 208 pages | 6.5” x 9.5” B&W softcover graphic novel

item.title: F.A.R.M. SYSTEM: RAGE in stores now!
item.description: Rich Koslowski’s original F.A.R.M. System graphic novel pulled back the curtain on the superhero community to reveal a satirical blend of pro sports and show business, filled with heroes and hustlers alike. Now the shocking sequel, F.A.R.M. System: Rage, explores the intersection of super-powers, performance-enhancing drugs, and American politics. F.A.R.M. System: Rage by Rich Koslowski $19.99 (US) | ISBN 978-1-60309-568-6 188 pages | 6.75” x 10.25” full-color softcover graphic novel

item.description: In the first volume of Rose Wolves, a young girl made a wondrous connection with a magical creature linked to a mysterious rose bush. Now she’s excited to share this discovery with her mom… but as the seasons change and the forest falls asleep for winter, the world of the rose wolves must change as well. item.title: MORE WEIGHT makes the THE NEW YORK TIMES "Favorite Hidden Gem Books of 2025"
item.description: "It took a decade to produce this densely packed 532-page masterwork of a graphic novel, and that effort is evident in Wickey’s riveting blend of hand-drawn visuals and storytelling. The book, which includes 55 pages of endnotes detailing its primary sources, examines the 1692 Salem witch trials and how misinformation and groupthink have impacted American history.
